thread:
jamal: Publishing the RCA for the model-routing regression that caused misrouted low-capacity traffic this morning. Internal doc: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.com/pm/1835123456 (internal access only).
infra-bot: RCA document uploaded and tagged. Abstract added, timeline and mitigations section populated. :robot_face:
leah: Reading now. Quick summary for execs? @ceo-karim
jamal: TL;DR: routing policy change combined with a stale compatibility table caused some requests to be routed to a GPU pool without the new KV cache layout. Resulted in higher latencies and elevated error rates for ~26 minutes. No customer data exposed.
ceo-karim: Thanks for the heads up. Appreciate the concise summary. Please include an executive one-pager in the doc.
leah: Copying the top action items here and owners — please ACK and update ETA inline in the doc.
```
- ACTION-A | Owner: jamal       | Revert routing policy change for critical-tenants; add a canary check in CI | Due: 2026-03-29
- ACTION-B | Owner: leah        | Fix compatibility table refresh path and add unit tests | Due: 2026-03-28
- ACTION-C | Owner: oncall      | Add alert for pool-version mismatch and paging rule | Due: 2026-03-27
- ACTION-D | Owner: product-ops | Update onboarding docs and add a compatibility gating step | Due: 2026-04-02
- ACTION-E | Owner: infra-bot   | Post-deploy verification job to validate KV cache layout across pools | Due: 2026-03-30
- CHECKPOINT | All owners       | Short status update in the doc by EOD 2026-03-26
```
oncall: Ill add the alert and paging rule. Will test in staging today. Tagging oncall when enabled.
leah: Ill take the compatibility-table fix. PR will reference the RCA and include tests. Expect PR in 24h.
jamal: Revert already in place for critical-tenants; initiating staged rollout of patched routing in 2 hours. Will post rollout notes in the doc.
infra-bot: Added a follow-up meeting: 2026-04-10 10:00 PT. Calendar invite sent to participants. :calendar:
product-ops: Adding an onboarding checklist item and a short guide for model teams. Will loop in docs owner.
ceo-karim: Please flag any customers impacted and coordinate comms with CS. Keep me posted if there is noise from enterprise tenants.
jamal: No customers reported data loss; CS is preparing a proactive note for impacted tenants. Will attach in doc.
leah: Thanks everyone. Please ACK the doc when youve updated your item. Well treat the April 10 meeting as the closure checkpoint for the RCA. :thumbsup:"
